meta.title: UNEMDE — deals nearby, activate in 30 minutes
meta.description: UNEMDE is an app for café and restaurant deals nearby. Book a slot and redeem with a QR code. UNEMDE Business is for venues.
meta.guestDescription: Find deals nearby, book a slot, and activate the discount in 30 minutes.
meta.venueDescription: Storefront, deals, QR scanner, and booking calendar for cafés and restaurants.
meta.partnerDescription: Partner benefits and an application form for venues.
meta.faqDescription: Answers about deals, accounts, and UNEMDE partnership.

hero.title: Discover the best offers around you with UNEMDE
hero.lead: Find discounts, partner places, and exclusive deals in cafés, restaurants, beauty, sport, and more — all in one mobile app.

how.title: Four steps from deal to table
how.sub: One flow for guests and venues: find an offer, book a time, activate on-site, and get the discount.
how.s1p: Venues nearby on a map or in a list. Filter by category, rating, and distance. Coffee, pizza, burgers, bowls, dürüm.
how.s2p: Pick a day and time slot. The venue does not see the booking until the guest activates the deal. Reserve a table separately if needed.
how.s3p: On-site — swipe or show a QR to staff. After activation you have 30 minutes to use the deal before it expires.
how.s4p: Dine in or takeaway. Track savings in your profile, save favourites, and rate the visit.

guest.title: Local deals you can actually use
guest.sub: Not a coupon catalogue for later. Each offer is tied to a time and place: book, arrive, activate.
guest.f1p: List and map, search radius, city or GPS. Top picks near you and new deals.
guest.f2p: Booked and Reclaimed in separate tabs. Swipe to Activate or QR. Money saved in CZK on your profile.
guest.f3p: Photos, hours, payment methods, reviews, directions and a call. Favourites in one tap.

biz.title: Counter, calendar, and deals in one venue app
biz.sub: Built for cafés, bakeries, and restaurants. Publish offers guests see in UNEMDE, then redeem them on-site with the scanner.
biz.f1p: Name, photo, address, hours, payments. Create deals: 1+1, 30% off, coffee 2+1, quantity and terms.
biz.f2p: Camera on the guest QR or a manual code. Confirmation: deal is activated — the discount runs until it expires.
biz.f3p: Day slots with guest name and deal label. Profile shows total deals and average bill.
biz.st1: Counter scanning instead of paper coupons
biz.st2: Deals booked by the guest for a specific time
biz.st3: Average bill and number of activated deals

apps.title: Choose your UNEMDE
apps.sub: The guest app finds and activates. The business app publishes and scans. Together they are a local-deals marketplace.
apps.gText: Discover, slot booking, QR / swipe, Reclaimed history, favourites, light and dark theme. Languages: UK, EN, CS, KK, RU.
apps.g1: Sign in with a phone number
apps.bText: Register with an establishment name. Edit, Scanner, Calendar, Profile. Same design system: Sofia Pro and the blue gradient.

cta.title: Ready to find a deal nearby?
cta.sub: UNEMDE is for people who eat in the city. UNEMDE Business is for the people who set the table.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about UNEMDE
faq.moreSub: Our team is happy to help. We’ll get back to you within one business day.
faq.a1: UNEMDE is a mobile app that connects users with exclusive discounts and deals at local businesses — cafés, restaurants, and partner venues. Available on iOS and Android.
faq.a2: Yes. Downloading and using UNEMDE is free. We also offer a Premium subscription with exclusive deals and early access to limited offers.
faq.q3: Which cities is UNEMDE available in?
faq.a3: UNEMDE is currently available in Prague, Brno, Bratislava, Ostrava, Plzeň, and Košice. New cities are announced every quarter.
faq.q4: How do I use a deal?
faq.a4: Open the deal in the app, book a slot, then swipe to activate or show the QR code to staff. No printing — it’s 100% digital. After activation you have 30 minutes.
faq.q5: Can I use the same deal multiple times?
faq.a5: Most deals have usage limits (for example once per week or once per visit). The app shows how many times you can use each offer and when it resets.
faq.a6: Yes. Each deal has a date and time on its detail page. Save favourites so you don’t miss them.
faq.q7: Are there deals for delivery or takeaway?
faq.a7: Some partners offer dine-in and takeaway. Delivery is usually not included in the deal terms.
faq.q8: How do I create an account?
faq.a8: Download UNEMDE, tap Sign up, and verify your phone number with a code. It takes under a minute.
faq.q9: How do I delete my account?
faq.a9: Go to Profile → Account details → Delete account. Your data is removed in accordance with GDPR. Need help? support@unemde.app.
faq.a10: Premium unlocks exclusive deals, early access to limited-time offers, and ad-free browsing. The first 3 months are free during the launch offer.
faq.q11: How do I become an UNEMDE partner?
faq.a11: Fill in the form on the Become a Partner page. Our team replies within 24 hours. No technical setup required on your side.
faq.q12: Is there a fee to list my business?
faq.a12: There’s no setup fee. Flexible monthly plans start from a small commission on redeemed deals.
faq.q13: How do I track how many customers used my deal?
faq.a13: UNEMDE Business gives you the scanner, booking calendar, and stats (total deals, average bill) in the venue profile.
